correctness.rationale: Theorem 1.3 of arXiv:2611.12847v1 establishes the closed connected PL manifold for every p,q>=1. Facets have exactly one unused vertex and every ridge precisely two extensions. The explicit full-permutation sign chain has cancellation of each ridge over Z, coefficients +-1, so it is a primitive global orientation class. Vertex-permutation action is sign; swapping factors at p=q multiplies by (-1)^(p^2+(p+1)^2)=-1. The free PL quotient is therefore nonorientable. Nine exact enumerated checks replayed. Critical general steps are proved, not inferred from finite testing.

value.rationale: The motivating paper specifically flags orientability of all mixed p,q as a conditional consequence of a conjectural homotopy classification. An explicit integral fundamental class settles this meaningful open structural point without that conjecture. The sign orientation character and uniform nonorientability of all unlabeled balanced quotients give a sharp geometric symmetry distinction beyond ordinary Betti numbers.
